title: Agent-written heuristics versus commercial solvers on unsolved job-shop benchmark instances
abstract: arXiv:2611.17682v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Commercial solvers are the standard tool for difficult scheduling problems. We study whether a frontier large language model, used as a coding agent with open-source tools only, can match them in quality and speed. We report every run, and independent checkers verify every schedule. On the 100,000-operation job shop tai_100_1000_1, an agent-written solver reached 525,515, below OptalCP, Hexaly, and CP Optimizer. Unchanged, it improved all ten instances of the family and closed two. With equal budgets on the same workstation, it ended 0.0-1.8% above the lower bound, against 2.6-5.8% for CP Optimizer and 2.4-4.4% for Hexaly. On the Behnke-Geiger flexible job shops, an agent-written tabu search improved 11 of 32 open instances. With two transport robots, an agent-written solver improved seven of ten MKT instances. New lower bounds show that four published MKT values cannot be attained on the distributed instance files. Agent-run improveme

translated_title: 代理编写的启发式算法与商业求解器在未解决作业车间基准实例上的对比
translated_abstract: 商业求解器是解决困难调度问题的标准工具。我们研究前沿大型语言模型——仅作为使用开源工具的编程代理——能否在质量和速度上与之匹敌。我们报告了每一次运行，并由独立检查器验证每一个调度方案。在包含10万个操作的作业车间实例 tai_100_1000_1 上，代理编写的求解器达到了 525,515，优于 OptalCP、Hexaly 和 CP Optimizer。代码未经修改，它改进了该系列的全部十个实例，并关闭了其中两个。在同一工作站、相同计算预算下，该求解器的结果距下界仅 0.0-1.8%，而 CP Optimizer 为 2.6-5.8%，Hexaly 为 2.4-4.4%。在 Behnke-Geiger 柔性作业车间问题上，代理编写的禁忌搜索改进了 32 个开放实例中的 11 个。在配备两台运输机器人的场景下，代理编写的求解器改进了 10 个 MKT 实例中的 7 个。新的下界表明，已发表的四个 MKT 数值在分发的实例文件上是无法达到的。
tldr: 前沿大语言模型作为编程代理、仅用开源工具编写的求解器在多个未解决的作业车间基准实例上超越了商业求解器，改进了大量开放实例并建立了新的下界。
en_tdlr: A frontier LLM used as a coding agent with only open-source tools produces solvers that outperform commercial solvers on unsolved job-shop benchmark instances, improving numerous open instances and establishing new lower bounds.
